meaning: Dots through the cloud of dust around the Ring Nebula's central star, spread as the shell model Sahai et al. (2025) fit to Webb's mid-infrared light of the star: from 10.5 to 1,310 au, the density rising outward as r^0.8. The cloud is far too thin to see in visible light, so the dots stand for dust an eye would not see. The position of a single dot is not a measurement: it comes from a seeded generator.
